title: The new urban societies
goal: Look at the new neighbourhoods, workers and middle classes of the cities, and say how they changed with verbs of change.
grammar: Verbs of change: convertirse en, hacerse, volverse

items: I can describe the neighbourhoods built by their own residents: favelas, villas and barriadas.
I can say what the trade unions asked for.
I can describe the new middle classes.
I can say what work women did and what they earned.
I can say how a place or a person changed with convertirse en, hacerse and volverse.
